experimental_method: Scholander microgasometric technique as modified by Douglas: equilibrated water or seawater, measured volumes of absorbed gas and of water; Bunsen coefficients (beta, ml CH4 at STP per ml water at 760 mm partial pressure) corrected for dissolved-gas volume with a partial molal volume of 37 cm3.
quality_remarks: Seawater of salinity 27.738-39.379 per mil (composition not given, not an NaCl solution); salinity 0.0 is distilled water. Authors say their distilled-water values are 3-5% above Winkler and Morrison and Billet. Bunsen coefficients already corrected by authors for the dissolved-gas volume (about +0.16%). Temperature scale not stated.
not_extracted_tables: Table II (constants of the fitted equation 1, model parameters)
Table III (Bunsen coefficients calculated from the fitted equation over -2 to 30 C and 0-40 per mil, derived)
